title: Excellent experience
text: Great experience, lots of history information while getting around on a bike. Highly recommended for Seville which is beautiful
author: Steven_D

title: Highly recommend bike tour!
text: We really appreciated Daniel accommodating a last minute private bike tour for my daughter and me. We were in Seville for less than 48 hours. In the bike tour with Daniel, we got a great overview of the city.  He was extremely knowledgeable and told interesting stories of the city. Even my teenage daughter, who is hard to please, had fun! I would highly recommend.
author: cindychen37

title: Excellent Bike Toir
text:
Our guide, Alfonso, was very knowledgeable about the history of the city. I enjoyed his enthusiasm and desire to share about the city. He took the time to answer questions thoroughly.

The tour was an easy ride, we got to see all of the major monuments of the city. The pace of the tour allowed us to stop at several stops and look around, so we never felt rushed. 

After our tour we got a complimentary drink from the bar next door and hung out with our tour guide getting to know him better. 

It was a great tour and would highly recommend it to others! Thanks Alfonso!
author: patrickcU8016GC
